ogTitle: Marysville Tile That Outlasts the Receipt
ogDesc: Bought your tile at a big-box store? Good. We build what belongs under it — membrane, flood test, photos — so a $3 tile lasts like a $30 one. From $14/sq ft installed. (425) 595-1079.

roles.heroLead: A $3 clearance tile and a $30 designer tile fail the exact same way in a Marysville shower — through the layer behind them, because tile and grout don't stop water and never did. The membrane does. We build that assembly, flood it for 24 hours, photograph the proof, and only then start setting.
roles.costH2: How much does tile installation cost in Marysville, WA?
roles.costP1: Totaled up, Marysville installs land in the $14–$26 per-square-foot bracket — setting materials, tile, labor and substrate prep all counted, labor being $11/sq ft at minimum. A tub-shower surround spans the $3,200–$6,800 stretch; a floor-shower-niche bathroom generally totals $6,500 to $14,000; and a lone bathroom floor, call it 45 sq ft, runs close to $900–$1,600.
roles.costP2: The number that catches value shoppers off guard: labor follows the tile's format, not its price. Mosaic sheets at $4 can cost more to set than $12 large-format porcelain planks, because installers charge for cuts and grout lines, not for your receipt.
roles.costNote: Current for Marysville homes in August 2026; tile, materials and labor sit inside these ranges. Build your plans on the written estimate — it's the real number.
roles.layersLead: From subfloor upward, count seven layers. When a failed shower gets opened, one is always missing — the membrane more often than not — a few hundred dollars saved at build time against a five-figure tear-out later.
roles.whyP1: Shower leaks give no warning at all. Grout admits the water, the substrate absorbs it, and the first visible sign — a soft patch in the hall, a stain spreading on the ceiling under the bath — arrives about two years too late. The repair list by then reads subfloor, framing, drywall — and tile again from square one.
roles.whyP2: Call waterproofing 10% of a shower's price. Deleting it to trim a bid is the most expensive line anyone ever cuts from a bathroom remodel.
roles.scopeIntro: Starting prices below — tile format, the condition of your substrate and layout complexity all move them. On-site quotes are written and free.
roles.cardShower: Base sloped, membrane bonded, flood test held — then we get to niche, curb (or none) and tile. The unseen half of the build is the half that decides everything.
roles.cardFloors: Kitchens and baths, plus entries, mudrooms and basements. The subfloor is leveled up front; if movement or a radiant mat is involved, an uncoupling membrane rides between.
roles.cardBacksplash: Mosaic sheet, subway, herringbone or slab-look porcelain — outlet cuts and edge trim done clean, grout matched to your counter instead of the tile box.
roles.cardHeated: Heated tile without luxury pricing: electric mat on an uncoupling layer, resistance readings taken before setting and again afterward, its own breaker. Only sensible while the floor's already torn open.
roles.cardRepair: Cracked tiles, failing grout, loose corners in the shower. We'll be straight about whether a repair will hold or the substrate underneath is already done.
roles.cardDemo: Old tile, backer and thinset all go, dust trapped behind plastic and a negative-air machine, debris hauled off the same day. Your driveway never sees a pile.
roles.materialsLead: Big-box tile is fine — we set it all the time in Marysville. What matters is matching tile to room, and that's where most regret starts. Here's the version we'd tell you in the aisle.
roles.materialsNote: Prices are for material only, install not included. We bring samples and say plainly which ones justify their cost.
roles.estIntro: Format, scope, prep, footage: the same figuring we'd do standing in your kitchen, minus the visit. It won't be a quote, but budgets have been built on less.
roles.daysLead: Set aside four to six working days when planning a Marysville bath. The middle days look uneventful; they're the ones doing the heavy lifting.

roles.faqQ1: How much does tile installation cost in Marysville, WA?
roles.faqA1: Marysville's going rate works out to $14 through $26 per square foot with installation — substrate prep, setting materials, labor and the tile summed together, labor never below $11 per square foot alone. Tub-shower surrounds mostly land in the $3,200–$6,800 window; count $6,500 up to $14,000 for a complete floor-shower-niche bathroom. Labor answers to format above all: a humble 12×12 sets quickly, while mosaic sheets and large-format each demand far more time per square foot.
roles.faqQ2: How much does it cost to tile a shower in Marysville?
roles.faqA2: Expect a Marysville alcove shower to cost between $3,200 and $6,800 — a number carrying the demolition, the bonded waterproofing system, a pre-sloped pan or base, the setting of tile, the niche and the grout. Full-height stone, steam, a bench or a curbless entry each lift it higher. About one dollar in ten goes to waterproofing — the piece standing between you and a tens-of-thousands repair.
roles.faqQ3: Do you waterproof showers before tiling?
roles.faqA3: Every job, without exception. Behind our tile sits bonded waterproofing — not bare cement board wearing thinset. That build means a base with pre-slope, walls wrapped in membrane, sealed pipe penetrations, seams and corners, and — before one tile is placed — a 24-hour flood test recorded in photographs. Water passes through grout and tile eventually; only the membrane keeps it off your framing.
roles.faqQ4: How long does a bathroom tile job take?
roles.faqA4: Give a Marysville bathroom four to six working days. Demolition with dust protection starts it; substrate plus waterproofing carry the 24-hour flood test; setting occupies one or two days; grout, silicone and trim finish. The grout then takes a 24-hour cure before the shower sees use. Floors on their own typically finish within one to two days.
roles.faqQ5: Porcelain or ceramic tile — which is better?
roles.faqA5: Wherever there's water or wear, choose porcelain: under 0.5% absorption, denser body, better chip resistance — floor and shower material, full stop. Ceramic earns its spot on backsplashes and walls, costing less where less is asked. In Marysville homes we keep porcelain underfoot and in shower pans, and let glass or ceramic handle the looks.
roles.faqQ6: Can you install a heated tile floor?
roles.faqA6: Yes — dollar for dollar the house's best comfort buy. With thermostat included, under-tile electric radiant runs $11 to $16 per installed square foot, and the moment to do it is while the floor's already up. The mat lies on an uncoupling layer, its resistance checked twice — pre-set, post-set — and it draws from a breaker of its own.
roles.faqQ7: Do I need to remove the old tile first?
roles.faqA7: Nearly always the answer is yes. Figure about $3.50 per square foot for tear-out plus haul-away — the price of actually seeing your subfloor, catching rot and movement, and keeping new tile from standing proud at the doorways. Going over existing tile works only on flat, solid, well-bonded floors, and even then it conceals exactly what demolition exists to reveal.
roles.faqQ8: How much does a kitchen backsplash cost in Marysville?
roles.faqA8: Installed, the usual 30 square foot Marysville backsplash comes to $1,100 up through $2,200, with outlets cut around, edge trim in place and grout blended to your counters. Layout hours, not material, set the top of the range — think herringbone, mosaic sheets, a picture-framed detail behind the range, or slab-look porcelain run tall.
roles.faqQ9: Can you fix cracked tile or regrout instead of replacing?
roles.faqA9: Often, and the savings are real. Repair and regrout open at $8 for each square foot, covering crumbling or stained grout, a few tiles cracked by impact, and corners overdue for silicone. What they can't save is failed substrate — hollow-ringing tile, loosening that spreads, a flexing wall — where patching just delays the bill. Diagnosis comes first here, pricing second.
roles.faqQ10: Which Marysville neighborhoods do you tile?
roles.faqA10: Everywhere in Marysville — Downtown, Sunnyside, Getchell Hill, Pinewood, Shoultes, Kellogg Marsh, Marshall, Cedarcrest, Whiskey Ridge, Soper Hill, Jennings Park, Lakewood and Smokey Point — plus Tulalip, Priest Point, Arlington, Lake Stevens, Everett and the rest of north Snohomish County.
roles.faqQ11: What warranty comes with tile installation?
roles.faqA11: Every OC Flooring tile job includes a 2-year workmanship warranty — carpet only gets one, but tile's problems emerge in year two, not week two. Choose a manufacturer's complete bonded assembly and their coverage layers over ours. And since membrane and flood test both live on in photos, your proof survives as long as the house does.
roles.hoodsOut: Don't spot your neighborhood? We work anywhere within about an hour of Marysville — mention it when you call.
